what_happened.line: The Select Board approved an all-alcohol license and change of manager for Jack's Country Variety.
The board confirmed consensus, four to nothing, that the town manager should move toward closing on 925 Mass Ave.
The board ratified the town manager's appointment of a police officer effective April 4, 2022, and made two board appointments.
The board approved a Unitil pole petition for Kilburn Street.
The town manager reported that unspent balances from finished capital projects would go to the FY23 capital plan.

why_it_matters: Taking title to 925 Mass Ave is the step the town would need before applying for remediation grants, and it would make the town the owner of a site with a cleanup question attached.
Leftover money from closed capital projects flows into the FY23 capital plan, which residents will see in the capital articles at town meeting.
watch_next: The annual town meeting warrant articles, which the board reviewed at this meeting.
The redlined bylaw review document, which the town clerk is to post on the town website once a presentable version exists.

reconciliation.summary: All five votes agree in outcome and substance, and the warrants, cruiser balance and chair arrangement match. The one thing to know is that our minutes record a consensus on closing at 925 Mass Ave that the official minutes do not mention, and the official minutes carry a bylaw/fall Town Meeting decision that ours do not.
